recall_authorities.authority_name: United States Consumer Product Safety Commission
recall_authorities.category_scope: United States consumer product recalls and product safety warnings
recall_authorities.why_authoritative: CPSC is the federal consumer-product safety authority and publishes the recall and product-safety-warning record on its controlled government domain.

live_test_fixture.probe_requirement: GenVM retrieval must return HTTP 200, strict UTF-8, and a stable committed snapshot before deployment.

known_limitations: CPSC pages and remedy details are mutable; the SHA-256 commits only the bytes assessed.
CPSC scope is consumer products; it is not a universal recall registry.
The domain allowlist does not cryptographically authenticate the publisher or the legal effect of a page.

marketplace_sources.stable_external_identifier: ASIN or marketplace-issued listing reference supplied by the operator
marketplace_sources.why_admissible: The source host is explicit and the marketplace reference is kept separate from mutable title, description, URL query, and evidence fields.

live_test_fixture.probe_requirement: GenVM retrieval must return the committed listing evidence without an anti-bot or consent interstitial.

known_limitations: Amazon may render, redirect, rate-limit, or block automated retrieval; a live probe is mandatory.
An ASIN or external reference does not prove ownership, title, physical authenticity, or current offer inventory.
SHA-256 binds retrieved bytes and does not authenticate Amazon merely because the URL is HTTPS.

live_test_fixture.probe_requirement: The exact bytes must be fetchable by GenVM and match the operator commitment.

known_limitations: This is content integrity and source admissibility, not publisher authentication.
The external evidence page can become stale; V2 has no in-place snapshot rewrite, so a new evidence policy or contract version is required rather than mutating history.

deployment_gate: Do not deploy unless the exact domains above and the frozen fixtures pass a multi-validator retrieval probe; no environment override is accepted.
